messages:
maya (PM): Support ticket S-4123 from Sokara requests streaming chat with incremental fncall frames to their on-prem webhook. Needs chunked JSON frames, resume after reconnect, and ordering. Triage?

sam (Support): They lost partial fncall state after a worker restart. Wants per-chunk header + ack token + resume cursor.

ravi (Sales): High priority; Sokara may sign multi-year Dedicated deal if we deliver. Need secure demo for compliance.

lina (Eng): MVP scope: JSON envelope frames (init, fncall_patch, fncall_end), seq/cursor, webhook ack with {ack_cursor}, resume via last_ack. SDK helpers for reassembly.

adrian (Platform): Security: support mTLS + signed JWT in MVP; HSM later. Also need retry/backoff, bounded queues for slow webhooks.

maya (PM): Launch criteria: API spec, security signoff, end-to-end demo with Sokara, resume tests, perf target p95 added latency <150ms. Recommend backlog ticket label=enterprise-streaming-webhook, priority=P1 for Dedicated trials.

lina (Eng): Est: 3-6wks core +2wks SDK +1wk security; +3-4wks for HSM.

sam (Support): Added ticket + sample webhook handler pseudocode.

maya (PM): Actions: sam add full payload catalog, lina confirm kickoff, adrian enumerate security options, ravi draft pilot letter. Move to backlog as P1.
